items.name: Fog-Walker's Belt
items.lore: Rangers' leather, with a rope knotted every pace: you count the knots to find your way back.

items.name: Rowan-Thorn Charm
items.lore: A rowan thorn in silver. The court's glamours slide off it.

items.name: Thrall-Breaker's Ring
items.lore: Cut from the iron collar of a geas-bound miner. He asked you to keep it.

items.name: Unbound Bracer
items.lore: Plain iron, no rune on it. Cormac says that's the point.

items.name: Crock-of-Gold Charm
items.lore: A single gold coin from a leprechaun's crock. It's always there when you check.

items.name: Iron-Cage Bracer
items.lore: Cold iron from a leprechaun cage. Fae folk flinch from it.

items.name: Trapper's Cloak
items.lore: Dull green and very quiet. The Queen's trappers wore them.

items.name: Cobbler's Ring
items.lore: Leprechauns are cobblers, really. This is a ring of shoe-leather and silver tacks.

items.name: Hide-Keeper's Torc
items.lore: The Rangers' own torc, for whoever held the hide on a bad night.

items.name: Black-Mist Charm
items.lore: A wisp of a dorocha's mist, caught in glass. It's always trying to get out.

items.name: Suitor's Ring
items.lore: A betrothal ring. The woman it was meant for never existed.

items.name: Glass-Heart Charm
items.lore: A heart of green glass. It beats, faintly, when someone lies to you.

items.name: Barrow-Wight's Belt
items.lore: Bound with mummy-wrappings. Clean ones. Mostly.

items.name: Hag-Bane Bracer
items.lore: Iron, with a hag-stone set in it: look through the hole and you see what's really there.

items.name: Unbetrothed Torc
items.lore: Niall's betrothal torc, never given. He wanted someone to wear it.

items.name: Grey Suitor's Cloak
items.lore: Mist-grey, and very old. It still smells of somebody's perfume.

items.name: Envoy's Seal-Ring
items.lore: The court's seal: a crowned woman. Every letter north was sealed with it.

items.name: Courier's Bracer
items.lore: A courier's arm-guard, slit for carrying letters.

items.name: Siabra-Lord's Torc
items.lore: Elven silver, black with the court's tarnish. It was a gift from King Lug, once.

items.name: Turncoat's Belt
items.lore: Lug's green on one side, the court's black on the other. Dorchu wore it either way.

items.name: Keener's Veil
items.lore: Grey as ash. Wear it and the bainshees' wail is only a sound.

items.name: Cnoc Aine Charm
items.lore: A pebble from the bainshees' hill. It's cold, and it hums one note.

items.name: Thorn-Lady's Brooch
items.lore: A brooch of black thorns. Lady Aoibhinn wore it over her heart, where the hag's heart was.

items.name: Lug's Promise
items.lore: A plain gold ring from the King's own treasury: given to those who carried the word of the plot to Tara.

items.name: Mantle of the Watchful
items.lore: The Host's green, for the ones who saw it coming.

items.name: Fomor-Rune Bracer
items.lore: Copied runes, burned into leather. Mor says they're harmless copied. Mor says.

items.name: Goat-Skull Charm
items.lore: A goborchend's little skull-charm. It bleats at night.

items.name: Goborchend Horn Torc
items.lore: Twisted goat-horn, bound in bronze. The goborchend wear their horns as trophies; you wear theirs.

items.name: Bloodhorn's Altar-Stone
items.lore: A chip from a goborchend altar. Druid Mor cleansed it. It's still red.

items.name: Oisin's Druid-Cloak
items.lore: Green and brown and full of pockets.

items.name: Fomorian-Bone Bracer
items.lore: The goborchend are of the old Fomorian blood. Their bones are heavy and hard.

items.name: Fort-Breaker's Ring
items.lore: Given to whoever first broke into a goborchend fort.

items.name: Rider's-Bane Torc
items.lore: Fear Dubh's bridle-iron, twisted into a torc.

items.name: Huntsman's Horn Charm
items.lore: A sliver of Fear Dubh's horn. Blow it and the court's hounds flinch.
